title: The Surprising Reason You Lean In During Conversations
hook: You unconsciously lean towards people you deeply connect with.

narration.text: You unconsciously lean towards people you deeply connect with.
This physical shift signals engagement, a non-verbal cue of interest.
Your body seeks to close the distance, mirroring emotional closeness.
It is a primal instinct, fostering connection and shared experience.
Notice your posture next time you are engrossed in a discussion.
Observe if you subtly shift closer, almost without realising it.
Try it right now, then comment if you noticed yourself doing it, like this if it surprised you, and subscribe to understand more about your mind.

description: Have you ever noticed yourself subtly leaning in during a really engaging conversation? It is not just you; it is a fascinating unconscious behaviour. This video explores the surprising reasons behind this common human tendency.
topic: Why you tend to unconsciously shift your weight or lean in when you are deeply engaged in a conversation. Observe your own posture.
